messages:
sara: Quick catch: the per-model cost heatmap is showing implausible dips when routing toggles run. Suspect our window-level aggregations lose variant context.
ben: Can you repro with a single tenant/window? We recently switched ingestion to compress variant counts which might be dropping counts below threshold.
sara: Repro: tenant=orchard, window=2024-06-10T11:00Z-11:10Z. UI unit-cost dropped 30% after a canary at 11:04.
li: If compression collapses low-count variants to "other" and we use that for baseline cost, the weighted average will be off. We should keep exact variant counts for the last N windows at least.
duke: Proposal: telemetry returns compact histogram: variant=count pairs as CSV string (e.g., "model-C:812,model-C-small:87,other:5") and a separate cached_tokens field. UI can compute weighted unit-cost client-side.
ben: That matches prior suggestions but be careful: some tenants have many tiny variants during A/B tests. We should cap to top-K variants and fold rest into other. K=3 seems reasonable.
li: Also need quantization state per variant. Add suffix like "model-C:int8:812" or separate small CSV for quant. Keeping it as CSV string keeps schema simple.
sara: UX ask: add an explainability line on the card: "unit cost computed from variant mix: model-C 90%, model-C-small 10%". If users toggle "simulate pin" we recompute cost with pinned weights.
duke: Simulate pin is cheap on the client if we have the histogram and cost-per-variant. We'll need a server endpoint to return cost_i for each variant for the selected window. But cost_i is just compute_ms/tokens for that variant — we can derive it from the variant counts and compute buckets.
li: Edge case: cached responses currently zero tokens; change to tokens_cached and tokens_remote. That avoids artificially lowering denominators.
ari: (from billing) Important: any UI amortization must be explicitly labelled as "preview - not invoiced". Billing must remain stable.
sara: Agreed. Action items: (1) li to add compact histogram CSV + cached_tokens to telemetry (INF-6110) (2) duke to mock client-side simulate slider and explainability string (INF-6111) (3) ben to run sampling bench to confirm payload size (INF-6112).
billing-bot: Tickets created: INF-6110, INF-6111, INF-6112.
